scientific_integrity: The theorem is analytically proved; the checker verifies polynomial identities and particular finite harmonic profiles rather than an exhaustive class of all polynomial vector fields.
scientific_limitations: The minimum is for a fixed circular physical-time trajectory and a finite-Fourier radial phase sensitivity. It is not claimed for arbitrary curves or unbounded-frequency phase profiles. Publication priority is provisional; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp polynomial degree for exact circular oscillator phase-response synthesis
